_format: Numbers written {base|upgraded}. cost_up = cost after upgrade. up = other upgrade changes. arch: Brandon, Nap, Tangents, General (character.json archetypes). mp = co-op only (MultiplayerConstraint). kw = keywords (Exhaust, Ethereal, Innate, Retain). Tangent cards list their lines as (1) (2) (3): only the lit line happens, and it moves on after you play any other card; as Dark Brandon every line happens. art = what the card portrait shows (the art tools add the persona and style). v1 design, 2026-09-24.

cards.name: Strike
cards.text: Deal {6|9} damage.
cards.art: Joe throws a folksy haymaker, aviators glinting.

cards.name: Defend
cards.text: Gain {5|8} Block.
cards.art: Joe braces behind a podium stacked with note cards.

cards.name: Catnap
cards.text: Gain {6|9} Block. Doze 3.
cards.art: Joe dozing upright behind a lectern, a little Zzz cloud floating over his aviators.
cards.note: The sleepy Defend. Doze pushes toward nodding off, which brings Dark Brandon.

cards.name: Here's the Deal
cards.text: Tangent. (1) Deal {8|11} damage. (2) Gain {7|10} Block. (3) Draw 2 cards.
cards.art: Joe leaning in and jabbing a finger mid-speech, three speech bubbles wandering off in three directions.
cards.note: Teaches the Tangent: play other cards to move it to the line you want. As Dark Brandon it does all three.

cards.name: Finger Guns
cards.text: Deal {4|5} damage twice. As Dark Brandon, 4 times instead.
cards.art: Joe firing double finger guns with a wink; tiny red laser bolts fly out.

cards.name: Red-Eye
cards.text: Deal {8|10} damage. As Dark Brandon, draw {1|2} card(s).
cards.art: An overnight train bursting out of a tunnel, its headlights glowing red like laser eyes, flattening a jaw worm.

cards.name: Aviator Glint
cards.text: Deal {7|9} damage. Apply {1|2} Weak. As Dark Brandon, hit ALL enemies.
cards.art: Sunlight flashing off Joe's aviators, blinding a row of cultists.

cards.name: Sleepwalk
cards.text: Deal {7|10} damage. Doze 2.
cards.art: Joe in striped pajamas and aviators, arms out, sleepwalking straight into a slime.

cards.name: Groggy Haymaker
cards.text: Deal {5|7} damage, plus 1 for each Drowsy you have.
cards.art: A half-asleep Joe swinging a wild, heavy punch at a beetle, eyes barely open.
cards.note: At 8 Drowsy: 13 (15). Rewards staying just under the nod-off line.

cards.name: Snore
cards.text: Deal {4|6} damage to ALL enemies. Doze 2.
cards.art: A visible snore shockwave rippling out from a napping Joe, knocking goblins off their feet.

cards.name: Long Story Short
cards.text: Tangent. (1) Deal {9|12} damage. (2) Deal {4|6} damage to ALL enemies.
cards.art: A speech scroll unrolling for miles, its end whacking a monster.

cards.name: Anyway...
cards.text: Tangent. (1) Deal {5|7} damage. Draw 1 card. (2) Deal {12|15} damage.
cards.art: Joe snapping back from a daydream mid-sentence and bonking a cultist with a rolled-up speech.

cards.name: Word Salad
cards.text: Tangent. (1) Deal {14|18} damage. (2) Deal {6|8} damage to ALL enemies twice. (3) Gain {10|13} Block.
cards.art: A tossed salad of floating letters and words raining down on a group of monsters.

cards.name: Malarkey!
cards.text: Remove all Block from the enemy. Deal {8|11} damage.
cards.art: Joe waving off a monster's shield with a dismissive 'come on' gesture; the shield crumbles.

cards.name: Full Steam Ahead
cards.text: Deal {8|10} damage. Draw 1 card.
cards.art: Joe leaning out of a passenger train's window, waving, as the train plows through a jaw worm.

cards.name: Cup of Joe
cards.text: Wake Up.
cards.art: A steaming coffee mug with a tiny pair of aviators on it; red laser light leaks out of the steam.
cards.note: The basic way to choose when Dark Brandon comes out.

cards.name: Morning Person
cards.text: Gain {7|10} Block. As Dark Brandon, draw 2 cards.
cards.art: Joe stretching at sunrise on a balcony, aviators on, suddenly very alert.

cards.name: Resting My Eyes
cards.text: Gain {4|6} Block. Doze 3.
cards.art: Joe with arms folded and chin on chest, insisting he's just resting his eyes.

cards.name: Counting Sheep
cards.text: Draw {2|3} cards. Doze 2.
cards.art: Fluffy sheep leaping over a tiny fence while a yawning Joe counts them on his fingers.

cards.name: Where Was I?
cards.text: Draw {1|2} card(s). Your Tangent cards move to their next line.
cards.art: Joe patting his pockets and flipping through shuffled note cards.

cards.name: Let Me Finish
cards.text: Tangent. (1) Gain {8|11} Block. (2) Draw {2|3} cards.
cards.art: Joe holding up one finger to stop a monster from interrupting him.

cards.name: Folks, Listen
cards.text: Tangent. (1) Gain {6|8} Block. (2) Gain 1 Energy. (3) Draw {2|3} cards.
cards.art: Joe with both hands raised to a crowd of puzzled monsters, clearly settling in for a long one.

cards.name: Chocolate Chip
cards.text: Gain {3|5} Block. Draw 1 card.
cards.art: A towering chocolate chip ice cream cone held up like a trophy.

cards.name: C'mon, Man!
cards.text: Apply {2|3} Vulnerable. Draw 1 card.
cards.art: Joe throwing his hands up in exasperation at a sheepish goblin.

cards.name: Mic Drop
cards.text: Deal {15|20} damage. Costs 0 while you are Dark Brandon.
cards.art: Dark Brandon dropping a microphone that lands like a meteor on a monster.

cards.name: Air Force One
cards.text: Deal {6|8} damage to ALL enemies twice. As Dark Brandon, 3 times.
cards.art: A blue-and-white jumbo jet swooping low over a battlefield of monsters, Joe waving from the door.

cards.name: Rise and Shine
cards.text: Wake Up. Deal {8|11} damage.
cards.art: Joe bolting upright out of bed with laser eyes, already mid-punch.

cards.name: Pillow Fight
cards.text: Deal {5|6} damage twice. Doze 3.
cards.art: Joe in pajamas swinging a pillow at a cultist; feathers everywhere.

cards.name: Sleeping Giant
cards.text: Deal {8|10} damage, plus 2 for each Drowsy you have.
cards.art: A giant, snoozing Joe rolling over and flattening a monster beneath him.

cards.name: Lights Out
cards.text: Deal {13|17} damage. Nod off.
cards.art: Joe flicking a light switch; the room goes dark except for a monster seeing stars.
cards.note: Strong for its cost because it ends your turn. Next turn you wake as Dark Brandon.

cards.name: Off the Cuff
cards.text: Tangent. (1) Deal {10|13} damage. (2) Deal {5|7} damage twice. (3) Deal {3|4} damage to ALL enemies 3 times.
cards.art: Joe tossing his prepared speech over his shoulder and winging it with wild gestures.

cards.name: Talk Their Ear Off
cards.text: Deal {4|5} damage for each Tangent card in your hand.
cards.art: A monster covering its ears as Joe's speech bubbles pile up around it.

cards.name: Malaprop
cards.text: Tangent. (1) Deal {10|13} damage to ALL enemies. (2) Gain {14|18} Block.
cards.art: Joe confidently pointing at a chalkboard where every word is spelled wrong; the letters leap off and attack.

cards.name: The Beast
cards.text: Deal {15|20} damage. Gain {6|8} Block.
cards.art: A massive armored black limousine ramming a monster, Joe waving from the back window.

cards.name: Amtrak Express
cards.text: Deal {3|4} damage for each card you played this turn, including this one.
cards.art: A silver passenger train at full speed with Joe in the engineer's cap, horn blasting.

cards.name: Put On the Aviators
cards.text: Wake Up. Draw {2|3} cards.
cards.art: Close-up of Joe sliding on his aviators as his eyes begin to glow red.

cards.name: Up All Night
cards.text: Can only be played while you are Dark Brandon. Gain {2|3} Energy.
cards.art: Dark Brandon at a desk at 3 AM surrounded by empty coffee cups, eyes glowing.

cards.name: Stare Down
cards.text: Apply {2|3} Vulnerable. As Dark Brandon, apply it to ALL enemies.
cards.art: Joe lowering his aviators an inch to stare down a sweating monster.

cards.name: Game Face
cards.text: Gain {8|11} Block. As Dark Brandon, gain 1 Energy.
cards.art: Joe in a locker room tightening his tie, jaw set, aviators on.

cards.name: Five More Minutes
cards.text: Gain {9|12} Block. Doze 4.
cards.art: Joe slapping the snooze button of a ringing alarm clock and pulling the blanket back up.

cards.name: Sleep In
cards.text: Gain Block equal to your Drowsy, plus {5|8}. Nod off.
cards.art: Joe buried under a pile of blankets while a monster pokes at it with a stick.

cards.name: Forty Winks
cards.text: Gain 1 Energy. Doze 4.
cards.art: Joe winking forty times in a row, a little counter floating beside him.

cards.name: Pillow Fort
cards.text: Gain {14|18} Block. Doze 3.
cards.art: A sprawling fort of couch cushions and pillows with a flag on top; Joe peeks out of the doorway.

cards.name: Lost My Train of Thought
cards.text: Shuffle your hand into your Draw Pile. Draw that many cards.
cards.art: A toy train derailing off a track that loops through Joe's thought bubble.

cards.name: Brain Freeze
cards.text: Each Tangent card in your hand moves to a random line. Draw {1|2} card(s).
cards.art: Joe clutching his forehead after a big bite of ice cream, stars and question marks spinning.

cards.name: Filibuster
cards.text: Tangent. (1) Gain {12|16} Block. (2) Draw {3|4} cards. (3) Gain 2 Energy.
cards.art: Joe at a lectern reading from a phone book, a clock spinning wildly behind him, monsters asleep in the gallery.

cards.name: Talking Points
cards.text: Tangent. (1) Apply {2|3} Weak. (2) Apply {2|3} Vulnerable. (3) Gain {8|11} Block.
cards.art: Joe reading from a stack of index cards, each one flying off to smack a different monster.

cards.name: Sugar Rush
cards.text: Gain 1 Energy. Draw {1|2} card(s).
cards.art: Joe vibrating with energy beside an empty sundae glass, spoon still in hand.

cards.name: All Aboard
cards.text: Draw {2|3} cards. Gain {4|6} Block.
cards.art: Joe as a train conductor on the platform, waving everyone on with his cap.

cards.name: Corvette Cruise
cards.text: Draw {2|3} cards. Your next Attack costs 0.
cards.art: Joe at the wheel of a green 1967 sports car, aviators on, hair perfectly unmoved by the wind.

cards.name: Reach Across the Aisle
cards.text: ALL players gain {1|2} Energy and draw 1 card.
cards.art: Joe stretching comically far across a chasm to shake an ally's hand.

cards.name: Wide Awake
cards.text: Whenever you wake up, gain {5|8} Block and draw 1 card.
cards.art: Joe with enormous, perfectly round wide-open eyes behind his aviators.

cards.name: Laser Focus
cards.text: Laser Eyes deal {4|6} more damage.
cards.art: Two thin red beams from Dark Brandon's eyes, perfectly parallel, slicing a boulder.

cards.name: Early Riser
cards.text: At the start of your turn, if you have 5 or more Drowsy, wake up.
cards.art: A rooster crowing on Joe's windowsill at dawn; Joe already up, aviators on.

cards.name: Power Nap
cards.text: Whenever you nod off, gain {8|11} Block.
cards.art: Joe napping in a hammock strung between two stone pillars while arrows bounce off an invisible shield.

cards.name: Snoring
cards.text: Whenever you nod off, deal {6|9} damage to ALL enemies.
cards.art: A sleeping Joe whose thunderous snores rattle the whole room; monsters hold on for dear life.

cards.name: Stream of Consciousness
cards.text: Whenever a Tangent card changes line, gain {1|2} Block.
cards.art: A river of floating words, pictures and half-thoughts flowing out of Joe's head.

cards.name: Long-Winded
cards.text: Whenever you play a Tangent card, deal {4|5} damage to a random enemy.
cards.art: A gust of hot air from Joe's speech blowing monsters' hats off.

cards.name: Amtrak Joe
cards.text: At the start of your turn, draw 1 additional card.
cards.art: Joe in his favorite train seat with a newspaper, a monthly pass pinned to his lapel.

cards.name: Bipartisan
cards.text: Whenever you play an Attack right after a Skill, or a Skill right after an Attack, gain {2|3} Block.
cards.art: Joe shaking hands with a red monster and a blue monster at the same time.

cards.name: Laser Show
cards.text: Wake Up. Deal {7|9} damage to ALL enemies X times.
cards.art: Dark Brandon's laser eyes sweeping the room like a rock concert light show.

cards.name: Dogfight
cards.text: Deal {6|8} damage 3 times. As Dark Brandon, 5 times.
cards.art: Joe in a vintage pilot's cap and aviators, strafing a flying monster in a biplane.

cards.name: Out Cold
cards.text: Deal damage equal to twice your Drowsy to ALL enemies. Nod off.
cards.art: Joe face-down asleep on a desk; the shockwave of his head hitting it has flattened every monster.

cards.name: Sleepwalker
cards.text: Deal {9|12} damage twice. Doze 4.
cards.art: A sleepwalking Joe in a nightcap marching through a dungeon, bumping monsters aside without noticing.

cards.name: Ramble On
cards.text: Tangent. (1) Deal {20|26} damage. (2) Deal {8|10} damage to ALL enemies twice. (3) Gain {15|20} Block.
cards.art: A tornado of speech bubbles, graphs and anecdotes spinning around Joe.

cards.name: Big Deal
cards.text: Tangent. (1) Deal {22|28} damage. (2) Nothing. You forgot the point. (3) Deal {14|18} damage to ALL enemies.
cards.art: Joe leaning into a microphone to whisper something huge; the monster's eyes go wide.
cards.note: Line 1 only happens if it's the first card you play after drawing it. As Dark Brandon, lines 1 and 3 both happen.

cards.name: Zero to Sixty
cards.text: Deal {20|26} damage. Costs 1 less for each other card you played this turn.
cards.art: A green 1967 sports car peeling out in a cloud of smoke, a monster flipped over in its wake.

cards.name: Motorcade
cards.text: Deal {14|18} damage to ALL enemies. Gain {10|14} Block.
cards.art: A long line of black SUVs and motorcycles plowing through a horde of monsters.

cards.name: Unleashed
cards.text: Wake Up. This turn, your Attacks deal double damage.
cards.art: Dark Brandon tearing off his suit jacket, eyes blazing red, as lightning cracks behind him.

cards.name: Second Cup
cards.text: If you are Dark Brandon, gain {2|3} Energy. Otherwise, Wake Up.
cards.art: Dark Brandon pouring himself another coffee from a steaming pot, eyes glowing brighter.

cards.name: Hibernate
cards.text: Gain {18|24} Block. Doze 6.
cards.art: Joe curled up asleep in a cozy cave under a heap of blankets as snow piles up outside.

cards.name: Sound Asleep
cards.text: Retain your hand this turn. Doze 1 for each card in your hand.
cards.art: Joe snoring peacefully while holding a fanned-out hand of cards to his chest.

cards.name: Deep Sleep
cards.text: Nod off. Your next Laser Eyes deal double damage.
cards.art: Joe asleep on a cloud, a dream bubble showing Dark Brandon with blazing laser eyes.

cards.name: Repeat the Line
cards.text: Play the last card you played this turn again, if it's in your Discard Pile.
cards.art: A teleprompter screen reading 'REPEAT THE LINE' while Joe reads it out loud, word for word.

cards.name: Moment of Clarity
cards.text: This turn, your Tangent cards do all their lines.
cards.art: A beam of light breaking through a fog of speech bubbles; Joe points ahead, suddenly crystal clear.

cards.name: Build Back Better
cards.text: Discard your hand, then draw that many cards. Upgrade them for the rest of combat.
cards.art: Joe in a hard hat cutting a ribbon in front of a shiny new bridge over a monster-filled moat.

cards.name: Ice Cream Truck
cards.text: Heal {6|9} HP.
cards.art: An ice cream truck pulling up in the middle of a dungeon, jingle playing, Joe first in line.

cards.name: Dark Brandon Rises
cards.text: At the start of your turn, wake up.
cards.art: Dark Brandon rising from a sea of red light, aviators blazing, cape of flags behind him.
cards.note: Every turn is a Dark Brandon turn: Tangents do everything, but Drowsy never builds, so Laser Eyes stay small.

cards.name: No Malarkey
cards.text: Whenever you wake up, gain {1|2} Strength.
cards.art: Dark Brandon cracking his knuckles as a pile of nonsense papers bursts into flame.

cards.name: Double Vision
cards.text: Laser Eyes hit twice.
cards.art: Two overlapping Dark Brandons, slightly out of focus, firing four laser beams.

cards.name: Well Rested
cards.text: Whenever you nod off, gain 1 Dexterity.
cards.art: Joe waking up refreshed in a four-poster bed, stretching with a huge satisfied grin.

cards.name: Heavy Sleeper
cards.text: Your nod-off line is {5|8} higher.
cards.art: Joe sleeping soundly while a marching band parades right past his bed.
cards.note: Bigger naps, bigger Laser Eyes, slower cycles. Copies stack.

cards.name: Off Script
cards.text: The first Tangent card you play each turn does all its lines.
cards.art: Joe crumpling up a teleprompter script and grinning; the audience of monsters gasps.

cards.name: Tall Tales
cards.text: Whenever a Tangent card changes line, its damage and Block go up by 1 for the rest of combat.
cards.art: A fish in Joe's story growing bigger in every speech bubble, until it's the size of a whale.

cards.name: Gaffe Machine
cards.text: At the start of your turn, {1|2} random card(s) in your hand cost 0 this turn.
cards.art: A clanking contraption with gears and a microphone, spitting out mixed-up words and happy accidents.

cards.name: Infrastructure Law
cards.text: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Energy.
cards.art: Joe signing a giant bill at a desk as bridges, roads and railways unfold around him like a pop-up book.

cards.name: State of the Union
cards.text: Wake Up. Deal {14|20} damage to ALL enemies.
cards.art: Dark Brandon at a grand podium under a vaulted hall, laser eyes blazing as the whole chamber shakes.

cards.name: Soul of the Nation
cards.text: At the start of your turn, gain 5 Block and draw 1 card. Laser Eyes deal 10 more damage.
cards.art: Joe standing on a hilltop at sunrise, a giant glowing flag unfurling behind him.

relics.name: Aviator Shades
relics.text: At the end of your turn, Doze 2. When you nod off, gain 8 Block.
relics.flavor: Nobody can tell whether his eyes are open. That's the point.

relics.name: Dark Aviators
relics.text: At the end of your turn, Doze 2. When you nod off, gain 14 Block.
relics.flavor: Replaces Aviator Shades via Touch of Orobas. They glow a little. Nobody asks.

relics.name: Travel Pillow
relics.flavor: Amtrak-approved. Smells faintly of the Northeast Corridor.

relics.name: Ice Cream Cone
relics.text: Whenever you wake up, heal 3 HP.

relics.name: Index Cards
relics.text: Whenever you play a Tangent card on its last line, draw 1 card.
relics.flavor: Numbered, then dropped, then renumbered. Mostly.

relics.name: '67 Corvette
relics.text: Whenever you wake up, draw 2 cards.
relics.flavor: Zero to sixty faster than you can say 'here's the deal'.

relics.name: Teleprompter
relics.text: Whenever you wake up, your Tangent cards cost 0 this turn.
relics.flavor: Reads everything on the screen. Everything.

relics.name: Amtrak Pass
relics.text: The first time you play 5 cards in a turn, gain 1 Energy.
relics.flavor: Good for one ride a day. He takes eight.

potions.name: Dark Roast
potions.text: Wake Up. This turn, your Attacks deal double damage.
